Olga / team —

Thanks for the ping. I reviewed Brightlane's order form and the standard publicity ask. Summary and draft guidance below.

Summary of our posture:
- Press mention (one-line): APPROVEABLE, subject to the exact wording and an internal embargo date. No legal quotes required beyond attribution.
- Customer quote: we need to review the quote text; minor edits may be required to remove customer-specific performance claims (latency/throughput numbers) unless Brightlane can evidence them in a joint statement.
- Logo use: APPROVEABLE with constraints. We require (a) a short brand use license (non-exclusive, limited to announcement, 6-month use window), (b) correct logo art (we will provide SVG), and (c) Redwood attribution line: "Redwood Inference is a partner in this pilot."

Requested artifacts from Brightlane for approval (please get these from Tara):
- Proposed 1-line mention (<= 20 words)
- Proposed customer quote (<= 40 words) with attribution (name + title)
- Exact logo mockup showing layout in the press asset
- Desired publication date / embargo window

If Brightlane is comfortable with a short brand-use license (we can provide a one-page addendum), Legal is comfortable approving without escalations. I've attached a redline doc (Redlines_Brightlane_MSA.docx) with the one-page publicity addendum and suggested language. Key points in the addendum:
- Limited use for announcement and marketing collateral for 6 months
- No sublicensing
- Customer will not attribute specific benchmark claims to Redwood without joint statement
- Right to withdraw permission with 7 days' notice

Please do the following:
- Olga: send the artifacts from Brightlane here when received.
- Lauren / Karthik: confirm whether Marketing needs any additional creative guidelines or an alternate approval SLA (we usually target 48 business hours).

-Kim
Kimberly Park
Head of Legal Operations, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai
